verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a Datadog API at /api/latest/ with API-key authentication and client libraries. It never states how the API is versioned and never describes a deprecation policy, so the applicable axis is unevidenced. The 'latest' path segment alone does not establish documented versioning or deprecation guarantees.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
